weather_report: Subiaco lies quiet under a spotless, inky sky, the small hours clear and still enough to hear the soft rustle of leaves. Come dawn, the dark will peel away to a lucid blue and abundant sunshine, the day looking clean-edged and dry with scarcely a cloud to smudge the light. Expect the sun to feel assertive once it’s up; UV will rise quickly through the late morning, so think sunscreen, a brim, and good sunglasses. A light layer suits the cool pre-dawn, then shift to short sleeves and breathable fabrics by midmorning. It’s a gentle day for modest pleasures: an unhurried walk for a takeaway coffee, windows open to let the house breathe, a quick round of errands on foot, laundry on the line, maybe a short cycle through the quieter streets before work. If you’re out around midday, pause in patches of shade and let the brightness do its quiet work.
